|lore=Docking bay security officer. '''Leader'''. Honored for bravery aboard the Star Destroyer ''Thunderflare'' where he rescued five officers from the wreckage of a shuttle crash.
|game_text=While aboard ''Thunderflare'', attrition against you is -2 here. Once during your turn, if at a battleground, may peek at top card of opponent’s Reserve Deck. If it is a character, may reveal it and opponent loses 1 Force (if it is a Rebel, may also place it on Used Pile).
|errata_history=This is version PC-E1 (2 of 2): a re-rendered image with the same words, first published 12 December 2022 as a partial slip and 3 January 2023 as the full card image. It is the current version. The image is the PC card image of this version.

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image of 3 January 2023<ref name="ht-kg-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/11d5d80/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Dark/large/captainkhurgee.gif captainkhurgee.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11d5d80 11d5d80] (3 January 2023).</ref>, no errata mark. If it is a character, may reveal it and opponent loses 1 Force (if it is a Rebel, may also place it on Used Pile).”
*: The lower part of this re-rendered card image (the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name) was published first, as a partial slip under the label “•Captain Khurgee” on the Players Committee's Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)<ref name="sheetP-20221212">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF, 2 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, Updated December 2022”; file created 12 December 2022).
